title: Reported speech: guided practice
instructionEs: Elige, decide y ordena. Fíjate en la estructura.

items.prompt: She ___ me that she was busy.
items.explanationEs: Con a quién (me): told. Said no lleva persona detrás.
Pregunta indirecta: orden de afirmación (I lived), sin did.

items.statement: They told us not to touch anything.
items.explanationEs: Orden negativa: told + persona + not to + verbo.

items.statement: He said me he was hungry.
items.explanationEs: Con a quién, tell: He told me he was hungry (o He said he was hungry).

answers: She asked if I could help her.
items.explanationEs: Pregunta de sí o no: asked + if + orden de afirmación. Can pasa a could.

answers: The teacher told us to be quiet.
items.explanationEs: Una orden: told + persona + to + verbo.
